00000|warning: Not a git repository. Use --no-index to compare two paths outside a working tree
00001|usage: git diff --no-index [<options>] <path> <path>
00002|
00003|Diff output format options
00004|    -p, --patch           generate patch
00005|    -s, --no-patch        suppress diff output
00006|    -u                    generate patch
00007|    -U, --unified[=<n>]   generate diffs with <n> lines context
00008|    -W, --[no-]function-context
00009|                          generate diffs with <n> lines context
00010|    --raw                 generate the diff in raw format
00011|    --patch-with-raw      synonym for '-p --raw'
00012|    --patch-with-stat     synonym for '-p --stat'
00013|    --numstat             machine friendly --stat
00014|    --shortstat           output only the last line of --stat
00015|    -X, --dirstat[=<param1,param2>...]
00016|                          output the distribution of relative amount of changes for each sub-directory
00017|    --cumulative          synonym for --dirstat=cumulative
00018|    --dirstat-by-file[=<param1,param2>...]
00019|                          synonym for --dirstat=files,param1,param2...
00020|    --check               warn if changes introduce conflict markers or whitespace errors
00021|    --summary             condensed summary such as creations, renames and mode changes
00022|    --name-only           show only names of changed files
00023|    --name-status         show only names and status of changed files
00024|    --stat[=<width>[,<name-width>[,<count>]]]
00025|                          generate diffstat
00026|    --stat-width <width>  generate diffstat with a given width
00027|    --stat-name-width <width>
00028|                          generate diffstat with a given name width
00029|    --stat-graph-width <width>
00030|                          generate diffstat with a given graph width
00031|    --stat-count <count>  generate diffstat with limited lines
00032|    --[no-]compact-summary
00033|                          generate compact summary in diffstat
00034|    --binary              output a binary diff that can be applied
00035|    --[no-]full-index     show full pre- and post-image object names on the "index" lines
00036|    --[no-]color[=<when>] show colored diff
00037|    --ws-error-highlight <kind>
00038|                          highlight whitespace errors in the 'context', 'old' or 'new' lines in the diff
00039|    -z                    do not munge pathnames and use NULs as output field terminators in --raw or --numstat
00040|    --[no-]abbrev[=<n>]   use <n> digits to display object names
00041|    --src-prefix <prefix> show the given source prefix instead of "a/"
00042|    --dst-prefix <prefix> show the given destination prefix instead of "b/"
00043|    --line-prefix <prefix>
00044|                          prepend an additional prefix to every line of output
00045|    --no-prefix           do not show any source or destination prefix
00046|    --default-prefix      use default prefixes a/ and b/
00047|    --inter-hunk-context <n>
00048|                          show context between diff hunks up to the specified number of lines
00049|    --output-indicator-new <char>
00050|                          specify the character to indicate a new line instead of '+'
00051|    --output-indicator-old <char>
00052|                          specify the character to indicate an old line instead of '-'
00053|    --output-indicator-context <char>
00054|                          specify the character to indicate a context instead of ' '
00055|
00056|Diff rename options
00057|    -B, --break-rewrites[=<n>[/<m>]]
00058|                          break complete rewrite changes into pairs of delete and create
00059|    -M, --find-renames[=<n>]
00060|                          detect renames
00061|    -D, --irreversible-delete
00062|                          omit the preimage for deletes
00063|    -C, --find-copies[=<n>]
00064|                          detect copies
00065|    --[no-]find-copies-harder
00066|                          use unmodified files as source to find copies
00067|    --no-renames          disable rename detection
00068|    --[no-]rename-empty   use empty blobs as rename source
00069|    --[no-]follow         continue listing the history of a file beyond renames
00070|    -l <n>                prevent rename/copy detection if the number of rename/copy targets exceeds given limit
00071|
00072|Diff algorithm options
00073|    --minimal             produce the smallest possible diff
00074|    -w, --ignore-all-space
00075|                          ignore whitespace when comparing lines
00076|    -b, --ignore-space-change
00077|                          ignore changes in amount of whitespace
00078|    --ignore-space-at-eol ignore changes in whitespace at EOL
00079|    --ignore-cr-at-eol    ignore carrier-return at the end of line
00080|    --ignore-blank-lines  ignore changes whose lines are all blank
00081|    -I, --[no-]ignore-matching-lines <regex>
00082|                          ignore changes whose all lines match <regex>
00083|    --[no-]indent-heuristic
00084|                          heuristic to shift diff hunk boundaries for easy reading
00085|    --patience            generate diff using the "patience diff" algorithm
00086|    --histogram           generate diff using the "histogram diff" algorithm
00087|    --diff-algorithm <algorithm>
00088|                          choose a diff algorithm
00089|    --anchored <text>     generate diff using the "anchored diff" algorithm
00090|    --word-diff[=<mode>]  show word diff, using <mode> to delimit changed words
00091|    --word-diff-regex <regex>
00092|                          use <regex> to decide what a word is
00093|    --color-words[=<regex>]
00094|                          equivalent to --word-diff=color --word-diff-regex=<regex>
00095|    --[no-]color-moved[=<mode>]
00096|                          moved lines of code are colored differently
00097|    --[no-]color-moved-ws <mode>
00098|                          how white spaces are ignored in --color-moved
00099|
00100|Other diff options
00101|    --[no-]relative[=<prefix>]
00102|                          when run from subdir, exclude changes outside and show relative paths
00103|    -a, --[no-]text       treat all files as text
00104|    -R                    swap two inputs, reverse the diff
00105|    --[no-]exit-code      exit with 1 if there were differences, 0 otherwise
00106|    --[no-]quiet          disable all output of the program
00107|    --[no-]ext-diff       allow an external diff helper to be executed
00108|    --[no-]textconv       run external text conversion filters when comparing binary files
00109|    --ignore-submodules[=<when>]
00110|                          ignore changes to submodules in the diff generation
00111|    --submodule[=<format>]
00112|                          specify how differences in submodules are shown
00113|    --ita-invisible-in-index
00114|                          hide 'git add -N' entries from the index
00115|    --ita-visible-in-index
00116|                          treat 'git add -N' entries as real in the index
00117|    -S <string>           look for differences that change the number of occurrences of the specified string
00118|    -G <regex>            look for differences that change the number of occurrences of the specified regex
00119|    --pickaxe-all         show all changes in the changeset with -S or -G
00120|    --pickaxe-regex       treat <string> in -S as extended POSIX regular expression
00121|    -O <file>             control the order in which files appear in the output
00122|    --rotate-to <path>    show the change in the specified path first
00123|    --skip-to <path>      skip the output to the specified path
00124|    --find-object <object-id>
00125|                          look for differences that change the number of occurrences of the specified object
00126|    --diff-filter [(A|C|D|M|R|T|U|X|B)...[*]]
00127|                          select files by diff type
00128|    --output <file>       output to a specific file
00129|
